notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
The free demo of WorldShaper Idle has been updated with the following new features:

 You can now save up to five builds and switch between them
 You can now see how to build tiles in the tile journal
 The smugglers' port has been rebalanced to be less overpowered
 A "Tile Count" button has been added to the tile journal

If you enjoy the demo, please wishlist the game to support it and get a notification when it's released! Thanks!
